owner_requirements: gb_feedback_1146: ONE new lever aimed at validity (3/48 valid is the real failure), vs frozen v0.0.19 on fresh seeds, preregistered as its own PR before the run
gb_feedback_1205: valid games >= 40/48 is a precondition checked BEFORE the win-rate criterion; fail loud (not null) if validity is not reached
question: Does training the hit-and-stay-up fitness against a standing frozen v0.0.19 (instead of the falling gen4 posture) produce a policy whose games against v0.0.19 are decisive (>= 40/48 valid) and won with hits?
lever: ONE change from v0.0.19: the training opponent in motor_gate.train is the frozen v0.0.19 (kind group_pd, eval noise 0.05) instead of the gen4 posture. Fitness (stand/3000 + hit_and_stayed_up(500)), model, initialisation (v0.0.19 final_params), ES settings, reset and ending are unchanged.
why_this_lever: cycle-0028: v0.0.19 lands head hits at ~0.52 s against the gen4 posture (which falls at ~1.46 s and never guards) but 0 strikes against a standing copy of itself (40/48 no-contests); the league's outcome signal vs v0.0.19 was 0-1 valid games per generation. Owner 11:46 suggested pool sampling from v0.0.13/16/19 with a min-valid constraint; v0.0.13 and v0.0.16 are already beaten 48-0 with 100% valid games, so they would add zero rank signal - the narrowest form is the v0.0.19 opponent alone.
classification: solo motor fitness against a frozen opponent (not competitive learning: no match outcome in the fitness); diagnostic, not an unassisted boxing result
env: grokbot.scenarios.RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000); unchanged jekko env; runs to the horizon (does not stop at the first fall)

gate.stance_pass: candidate stands (no persistent non-foot floor support) for the full 3000 ticks
gate.reach_pass: candidate lands >= 1 strike tick (approach and referee active speed >= 0.5 m/s on a strike target)
gate.also_reported: scoring_reach_rate (share of trials with >= 1 head/torso hit); not part of the primary gate
gate.note: motor gate still against the frozen gen4 posture, reported (not gating)

primary.name: validity precondition, then win-rate gate, vs frozen v0.0.19 on NEW seeds 10000-10023 (48 games)

head_to_head.env: grokbot.reference_env.ReferenceEndingEnv(RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000), anti_stalling=True) via grokbot.selfplay.play_game (ending v2, unchanged)
head_to_head.candidate: the trained v0.0.21 GroupPDPolicy, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.opponent: frozen v0.0.19: kind group_pd, v0.0.19 final_params, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.sides: each seed with the candidate in corner A and in corner B (48 games)
head_to_head.valid: grokbot.selfplay.valid_result; every game stays in the denominator
head_to_head.elo: Elo = 400*log10(p/(1-p)) with p = (1+mean)/2 clipped to [0.5/n, 1-0.5/n]; Elo lower bound from p_low = (1+lower95)/2 (-inf if p_low <= 0); win rate with a Wilson 95% interval (descriptive)

order: 1. validity precondition: valid primary games >= 40 of 48 (selfplay.valid_result). If NOT met: verdict VALIDITY_FAILED, the win-rate criteria are not evaluated, the probe exits non-zero (fail loud). This is a failure, not a null and not a pass.
2. only if validity holds: (b) Hoeffding lower95 > 0 (Elo lower bound > 0) AND (c) >= half of the candidate's valid wins with >= 1 candidate head/torso hit
primary.level_up: v0.0.21 is a level-up (tagged v0.0.21) iff verdict == LEVEL_UP (validity precondition AND b AND c)

secondary_reported_not_gating.baseline_validity: v0.0.19 self-mirror on the primary seeds 10000-10023 (expected near-zero validity, cycle-0028)
secondary_reported_not_gating.vs_v0016: candidate vs frozen v0.0.16 on seeds 11000-11023 (48 games)
secondary_reported_not_gating.vs_v0013: candidate vs frozen v0.0.13 on seeds 11000-11023 (48 games)
secondary_reported_not_gating.motor_gate: candidate and v0.0.19 (re-run, checked per trial against its committed summary) on the 24 motor-gate seeds vs gen4
secondary_reported_not_gating.training: per-iteration stand time, scoring_share and hit_and_up_share against v0.0.19

red_team_notes: The validity threshold 40/48 is strict: v0.0.19 itself reaches 3/48 against v0.0.19 (cycle-0028)
Body collisions (blocked) count as invalid; v0.0.18 vs v0.0.19 was 92% blocked, so hits alone may not reach 40/48
No game has been played on seeds 10000-10023 or 11000-11023; the probe smoke test used seeds 99990-99993
pre_declared_readings: LEVEL_UP: tag v0.0.21; next preregister a self-play league seeded from it (its games against the champion are now decisive)
VALIDITY_FAILED with mostly no-contests: hitting a standing guard is still not learned; next lever: aiming feedback (glove-to-head offset) in the controller
VALIDITY_FAILED with mostly blocked: hits arrive but bodies collide; next lever: separation 0.6 m or a clinch-break ending rule
CRITERION_NOT_MET (valid but b or c fails): decisive games but no superiority or balance-only wins; next lever: longer training against v0.0.19
